questions.stem: Which of the following is a decimal fraction?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 7/10 because a decimal fraction has a denominator of 10, 100, 1000, etc. 3/4, 2/5, and 1/3 do not have denominators that are powers of 10.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक दशमलव भिन्न है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर 7/10 है क्योंकि एक दशमलव भिन्न के हर 10, 100, 1000 आदि होते हैं। 3/4, 2/5 और 1/3 के हर 10 के घात नहीं होते।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question, with appropriate terminology and correct answer placement.

mr.solution: बरोबर उत्तर 7/10 आहे कारण दशांश अपूर्णांकाचा छेद 10, 100, 1000, इत्यादी असतो. 3/4, 2/5 आणि 1/3 चा छेद 10 च्या घातींनी नसतो.

distractorReason: Confuses decimal fractions with common fractions
Fails to recognize that the denominator must be a power of 10
Believes any fraction can be a decimal fraction regardless of denominator
questions.critique: The solution is correct. A decimal fraction is defined as a fraction with a denominator that is a power of 10, and 7/10 fits this definition. The other options do not.

questions.stem: If 0.75 is written as a common fraction, what is its simplest form?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 3/4 because 0.75 can be written as 75/100, which simplifies to 3/4. 5/6 is not equivalent to 0.75, 7/10 is 0.7, and 1/2 is 0.5.

mr.solution: बरोबर उत्तर 3/4 आहे कारण 0.75 ला 75/100 म्हणून लिहिता येईल, जे 3/4 मध्ये सोपे केले जाऊ शकते. 5/6 0.75 च्या बरोबरीचे नाही, 7/10 हे 0.7 आहे आणि 1/2 हे 0.5 आहे.
